$comment: Generated by npm run schemas from bot/src/settings-catalog.ts; don't edit.

settings.label: Bot token
settings.help: From the Discord developer portal (Bot → Reset Token). Needed to log in.

settings.label: Application ID
settings.help: The application's ID (General Information). Needed to register the /scrib commands.

settings.label: Server ID for commands
settings.blankMeans: register globally (takes up to an hour)
settings.help: Register the /scrib commands to this one server, where they appear at once.

settings.label: API token
settings.help: Shared secret between the bot, the Foundry module and the Console. Paste the same value into the module's settings (the headless client sets it there by itself).

warnings.text: Still the example value. Generate a real secret.

settings.label: Foundry address(es)
settings.help: Comma-separated web origins allowed to call the bot: your Foundry URL, e.g. https://foundry.example.com.

settings.label: Headless Foundry client

options.label: Off: a person's browser is the bridge
Session: join while recording and to import
Always: stay joined while the bot runs

settings.help: Have the bot join Foundry itself in a headless browser, as the module's Bridge user, so nobody has to keep a browser open.

settings.label: Foundry URL
settings.help: Foundry's base URL for the headless client. It must also be in the Foundry addresses above.

settings.label: Foundry user
settings.help: The Foundry player the headless client logs in as. Set it as the module's Bridge user.

settings.label: Foundry password
settings.help: That user's password.

settings.label: Browser
settings.help: msedge, chrome, chromium, or a path to a Chromium-based browser.

settings.label: Bot URL as the browser sees it
settings.help: The bot's API address written into the module's settings in the headless browser.

settings.label: Wait for the chat log (seconds)
settings.help: After a recording stops, how long the summary waits for Foundry's chat log before going without it.

settings.label: Announce in Foundry chat
settings.help: Post in Foundry's chat when ScribBot joins (and why) and before it leaves.

settings.label: Speech-to-text engine

options.label: Whisper: much more accurate, best on an NVIDIA GPU

settings.help: Whisper needs the optional install: in worker/, .venv\Scripts\pip install -e ".[whisper,cuda]" (or ".[whisper]" for CPU only).

settings.label: Language
settings.help: The language spoken at the table.

settings.label: Whisper model
settings.help: Downloaded on first use (large-v3 is about 3 GB).

settings.label: Whisper device
settings.help: Where Whisper runs.

warnings.text: Whisper on the CPU is several times slower than on a GPU; long sessions may fall behind.

settings.label: Precision
settings.blankMeans: float16 on CUDA, int8 on CPU
settings.help: CTranslate2 compute type override.

settings.label: Beam size
settings.help: Beam search width for short clips (1 = greedy, fastest).

warnings.text: Wider beams are slower on every clip for little gain on short speech.

settings.label: Hotwords per clip
settings.help: Names sent with each clip (party, then glossary, then Foundry actors; 0 = none).

warnings.text: Long hotword lists make Whisper write names instead of speech, and decoding slows down.

settings.label: No hotwords below (seconds)
settings.help: Clips shorter than this get no hotwords: on near-silence Whisper writes the list back out.

warnings.text: Short, quiet clips will more often come back as a list of names.

settings.label: Skip silent clips (VAD)
settings.help: Check each clip for speech on the CPU (Silero VAD) first; clips without speech never reach the model.

warnings.text: Every clip, silence included, goes to the model. Silent clips took 19–56 s each before this check.

settings.label: VAD threshold
settings.help: Speech probability (0–1) a clip needs to be transcribed.

settings.label: Drop filler clips shorter than (seconds)
settings.help: A clip that is only "thank you", "you", "bye"… is dropped when shorter than this and decoded with low confidence (0 = keep them all).

warnings.text: Whisper's stock silence phrases will end up in transcripts.

settings.label: Filler confidence cut-off
settings.help: …and when its mean word confidence is below this.

settings.label: Whistle weights file
settings.help: Path to a local or fine-tuned whistle.cact.

settings.label: Re-queue clips on start (hours)
settings.help: On start, re-queue clips from sessions touched in the last N hours that have audio but no text (0 = off).

settings.label: Reload the model after errors
settings.help: After this many model errors in a row, reload the model; if that fails the worker restarts (0 = never).

settings.label: Log slow clips after (seconds)
settings.help: Log a clip that has been transcribing longer than this (0 = never).

settings.label: Provider
settings.help: Who writes the summaries. Only transcript text and campaign notes are sent.

settings.label: Model
settings.help: Required for OpenAI-compatible providers.

settings.label: Anthropic API key
settings.help: Leave blank to use an `ant auth login` profile instead.

settings.label: Base URL
settings.help: e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.

settings.label: API key
settings.help: Not needed for most local servers.

settings.label: Minutes per chunk
settings.help: Minutes of transcript per extraction pass.

settings.label: Summarize automatically
settings.help: Send every transcript to the LLM when it's done. Off: sessions end at a saved transcript until someone asks for a summary.

settings.label: Data folder
settings.help: Recordings, transcripts, summaries, logs and the database. Relative paths start at the repo root.

settings.label: Campaign folder
settings.help: glossary.md and context.md: names and lore for speech-to-text and the summarizer.

settings.label: Delete audio once transcribed
settings.help: Each clip is transcribed as soon as the speaker pauses and its audio deleted. Saves disk, but sessions can't be re-transcribed later.

settings.label: Keep audio (days)
settings.help: When audio is kept: delete it this many days after a session is summarized (0 = forever).

settings.label: Empty the trash after (days)
settings.help: Sessions deleted from the Console wait in data/trash this long (0 = until emptied by hand).

settings.label: Bot API address
settings.help: Keep 127.0.0.1 unless the bot sits behind an HTTPS proxy.

warnings.text: The bot's API would answer the whole network.

settings.label: Bot API port
settings.help: The Foundry module and the Console reach the bot here.

settings.label: Worker URL
settings.help: The transcription worker listens on this address.

settings.label: Console port
settings.help: This page (always on 127.0.0.1). The old MONITOR_PORT is still read when this is blank.

settings.label: Console log copy folder
settings.help: Where the Console keeps daily copies of the bot's log (scribbot-YYYY-MM-DD.log), so the lines before a crash survive it.

settings.label: Resume recording after a restart (minutes)
settings.help: After a crash or restart, rejoin a session that was recording less than this long ago (0 = never).

settings.label: Warn when transcription is behind (minutes)
settings.help: Post one warning in the text channel when the worker falls this far behind (0 = never).

settings.label: Keep log files (days)
settings.help: Daily bot and worker log files in data/logs (0 = no log files).
